observations.body: Jesus responds to hindered children with belonging, receiving, entering, touch, and blessing.
observations.label: Receive the Kingdom like a child

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside receive the kingdom like a child.
observations.label: God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read Mark 10:12–17 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus responds to hindered children with belonging, receiving, entering, touch, and blessing. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: Receive the Kingdom like a child
